description: This PHP source file defines the LocalAuthProvider class, which provides authentication functionality within the OrangeHRM system. It handles user credential validation, password strength enforcement, and integrates various services and traits for configuration, internationalization, and password management.

classes.name: LocalAuthProvider
classes.description: Provides local authentication functionality within the OrangeHRM system, including credential verification and password strength enforcement.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of AuthenticationService used for authentication operations.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs authentication using provided user credentials, enforces password strength rules if configured, and manages security enforcement.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the authentication provider within the system, with lower numbers indicating higher priority.
